Flat vector emblem drawn with exactly three flat colours on a plain pure white background: pure black (#000000) for the main shape, pure red (#FF0000) for one or two small accent details, and pure blue (#0000FF) for a secondary part. No other colours, no gradients, no shading, no texture, no outlines, no text or letters. One clear subject, centred, filling most of the frame with a generous even margin. Clean, confident geometric forms like a crafted enamel badge: chunky, high-contrast and legible at a tiny size.
